scope: read-only diagnosis of the completed bounded C run
cause: The original scheduler treated a generic invoice BLOCKED result as recovery eligible.
Those four invoice proposals named only the authorization claim and omitted total_charge, so the controlled revoked freight root was not a dependency of the proposal.
The recovery adapter then rejected the replacement as unrelated; the controller did not preserve worker stderr in the original run and recorded the missing response as KeyError recovery.
A copied receiver directory reproduced the underlying worker exception as ValueError: unrelated or duplicate replacement, without changing the completed run.
correction: The parser now rejects an invoice approve or verify whose claims do not exactly match the complete candidate claim set.
Recovery now requires the blocked output to name the controlled revoked root before it starts.
Future worker failures retain bounded stderr details for diagnosis.
